import {defineOvsComponent} from 'ovsjs';
import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  const msg = "You did it!";
  let count = ref(0);
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    count.value = count.value + 1;
  },1000);
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
    count.value = 0;
  }},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
    count,
    $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ])
  ]);
});

// HelloWorld OVS Component

// 编译器会自动添加 import { $OvsHtmlTag } from 'ovsjs'

  count.value = count.value + 1
}, 1000);

import {defineOvsComponent} from 'ovsjs';
import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  const msg = "You did it!";
  let count = ref(0);
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    count.value = count.value + 1;
  },1000);
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
    count.value = 0;
  }},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
    count,
    $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ])
  ]);
});

import {defineOvsComponent} from 'ovsjs';
import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  const msg = "You did it!";
  let count = ref(0);
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    count.value = count.value + 1;
  },1000);
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
    count.value = 0;
  }},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
    h2,
    count,
    $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ])
  ]);
});

import {defineOvsComponent} from 'ovsjs';
import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  const msg = "You did it!";
  let count = ref(0);
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    count.value = count.value + 1;
  },1000);
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
    count.value = 0;
  }},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
    $OvsHtmlTag.h2({},["fasdf"]),
    count,
    $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ])
  ]);
});

import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  const msg = "You did it!";
  let count = ref(0);
  const timer = setInterval(() => {
    count.value = count.value + 1;

  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){

  count.value = count.value + 1

// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
ovsView CountDisplay(props): div({ class: 'count-display' }) {

}, 1000);

ovsView CountDisplay(props): div({ class: 'count-display' }) {

import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref,Fragment,h} from 'vue';
const msg = "You did it!";
let count = ref(0);
const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1;
},1000);
function CountDisplay(props){
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),
    $OvsHtmlTag.strong({style:'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;'},[props.count])
  ]);
}
export default h(Fragment,null,[
  h,
  $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
    count.value = 0;
  }},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
    CountDisplay({count:count.value}),
    $OvsHtmlTag.p({style:'color: #888; font-size: 12px;'},['(Click anywhere to reset)']),
    $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ])
  ])
]);

import { ref } from 'vue';

const msg = "You did it!"
let count = ref(0)

const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1
}, 1000);

// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
ovsView CountDisplay(props): div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
  span { 'Current count: ' }
  strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
}

// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count: count.value })

  p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }

[2025-12-06T11:40:15.127Z]
import { ref } from 'vue';

const msg = "You did it!"
let count = ref(0)

const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1
}, 1000);

// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
ovsView CountDisplay(props): div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
  span { 'Current count: ' }
  strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
}

// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count: count })

  p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'OVS' }
    '.'
  }
}

import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
const msg = "You did it!";
let count = ref(0);
const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1;
},1000);
function CountDisplay(props){
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),
    $OvsHtmlTag.strong({style:'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;'},[props.count])
  ]);
}
export default $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
  count.value = 0;
}},[
  $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
  CountDisplay({count:count}),
  $OvsHtmlTag.p({style:'color: #888; font-size: 12px;'},['(Click anywhere to reset)']),
  $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
    "You've successfully created a project with ",
    $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
    ' + ',
    $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
    ' + ',
    $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
    '.'
  ])
]);

[2025-12-06T11:40:28.831Z]
import { ref } from 'vue';

const msg = "You did it!"
let count = ref(0)

const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1
}, 1000);

// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
ovsView CountDisplay(props): div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
  span { 'Current count: ' }
  strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
}

// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count })

  p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'OVS' }
    '.'
  }
}

import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
const msg = "You did it!";
let count = ref(0);
const timer = setInterval(() => {
  count.value = count.value + 1;
},1000);
function CountDisplay(props){
  return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
    $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),
    $OvsHtmlTag.strong({style:'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;'},[props.count])
  ]);
}
export default $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
  count.value = 0;
}},[
  $OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]),
  CountDisplay({count}),
  $OvsHtmlTag.p({style:'color: #888; font-size: 12px;'},['(Click anywhere to reset)']),
  $OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
    "You've successfully created a project with ",
    $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
    ' + ',

    '.'
  ])
]);

import { ref } from 'vue';


// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
// view 是软关键字，可以在其他地方作为变量名使用
view CountDisplay(props) {
  div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
    span { 'Current count: ' }
    strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
  }
}

// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
 

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'OVS' }
    '.'
  }


    const msg = "You did it!"
    let count = ref(0)

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      count.value = count.value + 1
    }, 1000);


  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  const countView= span{count}



  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count:countView })

 p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }
}

export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  function CountDisplay(props){
    return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
      $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),

    const children = [];
    const temp$$attrs$$rgxch6sp = {};
    children.push($OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[

      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),

import { ref } from 'vue';


// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
// view 是软关键字，可以在其他地方作为变量名使用
view CountDisplay(props) {
  div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
    span { 'Current count: ' }
    strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
  }
}


// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
 

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'OVS' }
    '.'
  }


    const msg = "You did it!"
    let count = ref(0)

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      count.value = count.value + 1
    }, 1000);


  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  const countView= span{count}



  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count:countView })

 p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }
}

import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';

export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  function CountDisplay(props){
    return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
      $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),
      $OvsHtmlTag.strong({style:'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;'},[props.count])
    ]);
  }
  return (function(){
    const children = [];
    const temp$$attrs$$b1qzcsbv = {};

      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ]));
    const msg = "You did it!";
    let count = ref(0);

import { ref } from 'vue';


// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
// view 是软关键字，可以在其他地方作为变量名使用
view CountDisplay(props) {
  div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
    span { 'Current count: ' }
    strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
  }
}



// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
 

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'OVS' }
    '.'
  }


    const msg = "You did it!"
    let count = ref(0)

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      count.value = count.value + 1
    }, 1000);


  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  const countView= span{count}



  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count:countView })

 p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }
}

import {defineOvsComponent} from 'ovsjs';
import {$OvsHtmlTag} from 'ovsjs';
import {ref} from 'vue';
export default defineOvsComponent(props => {
  function CountDisplay(props){
    return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'count-display'},[
      $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),
      $OvsHtmlTag.strong({style:'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;'},[props.count])
    ]);
  }
  return (function(){
    const children = [];
    const temp$$attrs$$3vrexalo = {};
    children.push($OvsHtmlTag.h3({},[
      "You've successfully created a project with ",
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vite.dev/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vite']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://vuejs.org/',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['Vue 3']),
      ' + ',
      $OvsHtmlTag.a({href:'https://github.com/alamhubb/ovsjs',target:'_blank',rel:'noopener'},['OVS']),
      '.'
    ]));
    const msg = "You did it!";
    let count = ref(0);
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      count.value = count.value + 1;
    },1000);
    children.push($OvsHtmlTag.h1({class:'green'},[msg]));
    const countView = $OvsHtmlTag.span({},[count]);
    children.push(CountDisplay({count:countView}));
    children.push($OvsHtmlTag.p({style:'color: #888; font-size: 12px;'},['(Click anywhere to reset)']));
    return $OvsHtmlTag.div({class:'greetings',onClick(){
      count.value = 0;
    }},children);
  })();
});

// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示

  div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
    span { 'Current count: ' }

  }

  function CountDisplay(props){

      $OvsHtmlTag.span({},['Current count: ']),

import { ref } from 'vue';


// 定义一个小组件，接收 count 并显示
// view 是软关键字，可以在其他地方作为变量名使用
view CountDisplay(props) {
  div({ class: 'count-display' }) {
    span { 'Current count: ' }
    strong({ style: 'color: #42b883; font-size: 24px;' }) { props.count }
  }
}

// 主视图
div({ class: 'greetings', onClick() { count.value = 0 }}) {
 

  h3 {
    "You've successfully created a project with "
    a({ href: 'https://vite.dev/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vite' }
    ' + '
    a({ href: 'https://vuejs.org/', target: '_blank', rel: 'noopener' }) { 'Vue 3' }
    ' + '

    '.'
  }


    const msg = "You did it!"
    let count = ref(0)

      count.value = count.value + 1
    }, 1000);


  h1({ class: 'green' }) { msg }

  const countView= span{count}



  // 使用组件，传入 count
  CountDisplay({ count:countView })

 p({ style: 'color: #888; font-size: 12px;' }) { '(Click anywhere to reset)' }
